name: Ancient Egg
summary: The Ancient Egg is a troll relic hidden in Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. Yeh'kinya seeks it because the Prophecy of Mosh'aru says it can contain Hakkar's essence.

sections.title: A Relic in Jintha'Alor
sections.body: Deep within the troll city of Jintha'Alor, the Ancient Egg lies in a cave beyond the amphitheater. Yeh'kinya seeks it in Tanaris, where he studies the Prophecy of Mosh'aru. The prophecy names the egg as a vessel for Hakkar's essence. Yeh'kinya fears that the world may depend on it.

faq.answer: The Ancient Egg is a troll relic from the age of vast troll empires. The Prophecy of Mosh'aru says it can hold Hakkar's essence.
The Ancient Egg lies in a cave deep within Jintha'Alor, behind the amphitheater at the city's summit in the Hinterlands.
Yeh'kinya in Tanaris seeks the Ancient Egg because of what the Prophecy of Mosh'aru says it can do.
Yeh'kinya believes the Ancient Egg may be the only way to keep the world safe from Hakkar's evil.

angles.text: As a troll, the Ancient Egg recalls the vast empires of your people and the power bound to their old relics.
